arguments.description: 16x16 pixel-art UI status icon for Ready, conveying successful completion of queued work. A clearly visible check mark with asymmetrical arms: one shorter arm and one longer rising arm. A bold centered silhouette using the existing UI's cool blue accent, visually related to #70b9ed, with optional lighter blue shading; no fixed palette. Transparent background, single static image. Readable silhouette at 1x and 3x nearest-neighbor scale on the actual dark navy #172336 panel. Deliberate clean pixel clusters and edges. For this sample propose an unadorned check mark without text, a backing plate or a drop shadow; exact stroke width and colors remain open to visual review. This is the representative Ready sample before family expansion, not an approved style reference.
